results.title: Trump to ease oil well methane curbs in bid to cut energy costs
results.description: President Donald Trump is set to unveil a plan to dial back federal requirements designed to slash methane emissions from oil and gas operations, casting the proposal as a way to encourage more domestic energy production and lower costs.

results.title: Microsoft to offer buyouts to 60,000 workers
results.description: Microsoft Corp. will offer buyouts to about 60,000 workers, representing roughly a quarter of its total staff, as part of the company’s efforts to trim costs and retool its workforce for the artificial intelligence era.

results.title: LT Foods Q2 Results: Net profit rises 10% on 17% revenue growth; margin falls
results.description: LT Foods reported a 9.9% YoY increase in net profit to ₹180 crore for the second quarter, while revenue rose 16.8% to ₹3,231 crore. EBITDA grew 8.7% to ₹336 crore, while EBITDA margin declined to 10.4% from 11.2% a year ago.
